leadText: Ed Goldfarb is the current composer of the score for the English-language dub of the Pokémon animated series and other dubs based on it. Goldfarb joined the series in Pokémon the Series: XY, replacing John Loeffler and David Wolfert. He is a member of The Sad Truth, who is credited for performing the English opening themes of Pokémon the Series: XY and Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. He also provides the score for Pokémon Evolutions in all languages.

Ed Goldfarb is the current composer of the score for the English-language dub of the Pokémon animated series and other dubs based on it. Goldfarb joined the series in Pokémon the Series: XY, replacing John Loeffler and David Wolfert. He is a member of The Sad Truth, who is credited for performing the English opening themes of Pokémon the Series: XY and Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. He also provides the score for Pokémon Evolutions in all languages.
